source.check: returned unopposed: the News-Letter of 19 May 1949 reports no contest in Castlereagh and names only four new members and the Castlereagh division (no nomination), so the retiring member was re-nominated; he elected chairman at the annual meeting of the new council, 10 June 1949 (eight days after polling day) (Belfast News-Letter, 1949-06-11, p. 5; block image BNL19490611.2.130 read) (round 2, 7 Nov 2026)

note: Triennial election of the electoral divisions of Castlereagh rural district, one member each. There was no contest in 1949. The News-Letter names the four new members and records that no nomination was received for the Castlereagh division, so the retiring member retained it. Three of the four re-nominated retiring members (Ballymaconaghy, Ballyhackamore, Gilnahirk) are recorded from reports of the new council's meetings (Belfast News-Letter, 11 June 1949; Belfast Telegraph, 12 August 1949), each with the division of the 1946 return; Craigavad remains unnamed (round 2, 7 Nov 2026). division inferred from the 1946 return (notice of result, Belfast News-Letter, 10 October 1946, p. 4); the meeting report cited names the member as sitting early in the term. No co-option or by-election for the division was found in the term. Returned unopposed.
